description: Bilingual search associations curated against catalog metadata. Roles distinguish statistical topics, demographic facets, weak hints and operations; associations are not interchangeable definitions.

concepts.note: Inflation is a change in CPI; the selector must still distinguish the index level from annual or monthly change. Cost of living is a search hint, not an assertion that CPI measures every household's costs.
Growth needs a volume change; GDP levels and growth are not interchangeable.
Participation and employment are distinct measures within the labour-market family.
Includes vehicle tables and related breakdowns; car rentals and household car ownership need different tables.
Category expansion only; never routes a question to a topic.
Category expansion only; never routes a question to a topic.
Suppressed when the same clause names a statistical measure. People are a subject, not automatically a population count.
A population denominator may require a second table, even when the numerator is a different topic.

concepts.clarification: Distinguish households from families, and specify the measure being asked for.
Rich can mean net worth, assets or income. Ask which measure and whether a mean, median or comparison is wanted; do not silently equate them.

concepts.note: Generic income is a personal/household hint; business income and public revenue have their own longer aliases.

concepts.clarification: Poverty may mean a relative income threshold or material deprivation; confirm the definition when it matters.
Rent may refer to rental prices, a rent price index, housing expenditure or tenancy status; confirm the intended measure.
The economy is broad: distinguish production, prices, employment, trade and public finances.
General prices need a product or market; do not assume CPI, house prices or a particular index.
Tourists may mean arrivals, airport passengers, accommodation guests or overnight stays; these are not interchangeable.

concepts.note: Marine products can be a trade category; exports/imports in the same clause refine this broad sector.

concepts.clarification: Specify the older age group; do not silently assume 65+, 67+ or any other boundary.
Specify the young age group; do not invent an age boundary.
Immigrant background, citizenship and country of birth are different classifications.

concepts.note: Explicit citizenship only: Iceland as a country is not a citizenship filter.

concepts.clarification: Specify the pollutant or environmental measure; greenhouse gases and other pollution are different statistics.

concepts.note: Historical station data, not a current weather forecast.

concepts.clarification: Specify the pension/retirement group; retirement or pension receipt does not itself imply a fixed age threshold.

_about: Bilingual search associations. concept/terms/search/tables are compatible with the tiered finder. id/role/aliases/search_terms/table_paths/table_phrases/broader/clarification provide richer metadata for role-aware consumers; the current harness does not automatically apply those fields. Terms are normalized and prefix-matched by the harness. Generic population hints are metadata-only; use explicit population phrases. Preferred IDs retain existing team choices and add selected financial/subject tables, not exhaustive lists. Subjective meanings and demographic thresholds still need clarification.
